paragraphs: By leveraging advanced data science techniques, I can contribute to Heathrow Airport Holdings' mission to improve airport operations and inform business decisions. In my previous role, I built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker. This experience involved creating models that can be integrated into operational workflows, ensuring they are both effective and efficient.

Additionally, I proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, and GitHub Actions CI. This tool was presented in a live stakeholder demo, demonstrating its potential to enhance decision-making processes through advanced analytics.
I have not used XGBoost yet, but I am eager to explore its capabilities as part of Heathrow's advanced data science toolkit.
